details.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$s=Get-Content '.coding-tools/task-state.json' -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; [pscustomobject]@{status=$s.status; current_step=$s.current_step; report_id=$s.completion_report_id; report_ack=$s.completion_report_acknowledged_id; report_ack_at=$s.completion_report_acknowledged_at; run_id=$s.orchestration.run_id; wave_id=$s.orchestration.wave_id; orch=$s.orchestration.orchestration_state} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress"
